text: Implemented EyeLinkAscNative typed parser and machine with exact source/block provenance, GAZE/HREF/RAW event summaries, signed integration offsets, lossless payload bytes, typed message categories, and preserved native metadata. Added 9 shared JVM/Scala.js tests and digest-pinned field-by-field eyelinker 0.2.2 parity in EyeLinkOracleJvmSuite. Full io evidence: JVM 108/108 and Scala.js 94/94; focused baseline JVM 15/15 and JS 9/9; scalafmt and git diff checks green. Mutation evidence: reversing offset arithmetic failed on JVM and JS with effective-time mismatches; swapping saccade start/end fields failed GAZE and HREF assertions on JVM and JS; both mutants restored before green baseline.
